SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-07' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END) AS july_2025_sales_pretax,
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-08' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END) AS august_2025_sales_pretax,
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-08' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-07' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END) AS absolute_change,
  100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-08' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-07' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END))
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) = '2025-07' THEN subtotal ELSE 0 END), 0) AS percentage_growth
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.orders
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) IN ('2025-07', '2025-08')
